title: Fix Claude Code's Web Scraping with this tool
description:
Claude Code can access and search the web by default, but it often gets rate limited, blocked, or stopped by a CAPTCHA it can't pass. Firecrawl fixes that. It lets your agent crawl and scrape the web reliably, automating tasks that the built-in feature can't handle. 

You can pull all the HTML from a page, crawl sites, and search far more efficiently than with Claude Code's built-in tools, so your agent can actually automate the web for you.

#techwithtim #ai #aiengineer #programming
